dslRule:
<!id: preference.editorEscapeStringsDefault>
<!description: Set default for EDITOR_ESCAPE_STRINGS to true.>
<!severity: INFO>
$store.setDefault(org.eclipse.jdt.ui.PreferenceConstants.EDITOR_ESCAPE_STRINGS, false)
=>
$store.setDefault(org.eclipse.jdt.ui.PreferenceConstants.EDITOR_ESCAPE_STRINGS, true)
;;
summary: Replaces 'false' with 'true' as the default value for EDITOR_ESCAPE_STRINGS preference.
